# Vendored from Hunk

This directory contains the upstream Hunk review skill, vendored so it is
available to all shared CLI agents (Claude Code, omp, Codex, Amp).

- **Upstream:** https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk
- **Tag:** `v0.22.0`
- **Pinned commit:** `3fdfde2dd77eb93802c43304c8edd34d79ce81de`
  (matches the `hunk` flake input in this repository's `flake.lock`)
- **License:** MIT — see `LICENSE` in this directory
- **Source path:** `packages/hunk/skills/hunk-review/SKILL.md`

The `SKILL.md` file is copied verbatim from the pinned Hunk package output.
When bumping Hunk, copy the file again from the newly locked package and
review the resulting diff.
